description:
SME - IT Operations Management, RESTful API, Angular

Noida, Uttar Pradesh

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Subject Matter Expert (Tools & Automation) plays a critical role in ensuring timely and quality resolution of escalated incidents and tickets.
